data.gender_notes: Asmaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word asma' meaning 'sky' or 'heaven'. The name Asmaah signifies one who is from the heavens or a heavenly being. The name Asmaah carries the meaning “Heavenly, Celestial” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asmaah usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly, celestial and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the angel Asmaa' who is mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Asmaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavenly, Celestial.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asmaah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أسماء

in_urdu.name: أسماء
in_urdu.long_meaning: أسماء ایک عربی اصل کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت ناموں والی، یہ نام حضرت ابو بکر صدیق کی بیٹی کا ہے جو نبی محمد کے زوج تھے، اس نام کو اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت دی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: अस्मा
